name: WSFx Global Pay Ltd
title: WSFx Global Pay Ltd - 511147 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 26% to ~INR111 crore and PAT up 77% to INR6.14 crore, but management flags Q1 FY27 leisure contraction of ~25% and a 0.6-0.8% net margin under pressure from new AD-II competition.

triggers.label: Leisure market down ~25% since March
triggers.quote: I can say 25% contraction has been there '25 March, April, May and we expect next one or two months to be a little challenging.

triggers.label: Trade remittance margins 20-30 bps
triggers.quote: In a trade remittance, it will maybe go down considerably maybe we'll looking at a 20-30 bps is the margins which we are looking at

triggers.label: FEMA 401/2026 opens trade and family maintenance
triggers.quote: FEMA 401/2026 RBI circular materially expands the addressable market for AD II players.

triggers.label: RBI stopped fresh FFMC licences
triggers.quote: RBI has also stopped issuance of fresh FFMC licenses strengthening incumbents' position.

guidance.value: Expect next one or two months to be a little challenging

red_flags.label: Competition on pricing; 0.6-0.8% net margin
red_flags.quote: obviously today we are having a margin of 0.6 to 0.8% if you see as a net margin.

red_flags.label: Credit card arbitrage took ~60% of intl spend
red_flags.quote: roughly 60% of international spends have moved to credit cards because of that

red_flags.label: Payables rise questioned, not clearly explained
red_flags.quote: The increase in current asset and liabilities is largely driven by the scaling of our card program

evasions.quote: I can only give you a broad-based structure. Later anything specific you can write to the company.
So when it comes to targets, obviously I cannot give you specific numbers.
Later anything specific you can write to the company.
